newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Five NZ work stoppages end in August 1996 - SNZ.
newsitem.headline: Five NZ work stoppages end in August 1996 - SNZ.

text.p: Five work stoppages ended in the month of August, Statistics New Zealand said on Wednesday.
All were complete strikes. Together they involved 2,287 employees and resulted in the loss of 4,164 person-days of work and about NZ$545,000 in wages and salaries.

There were 74 works stoppages which ended in the year to August, up from 66 stoppages in the previous year. The stoppages involved 35,025 employees and resulted in the loss of 45,622 person-days of work and an estimated NZ$6.6 million in wages and salaries.
As well as the five stoppages ending in August 1996, nine other stoppages were still in progress.
